faqs.q: What sets Solid State Construction's design-build process apart?
faqs.a: We unify architectural design, structural engineering, and physical jobsite construction into a single contract, eliminating miscommunication, delays, and surprise change orders.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured for large commercial construction?
faqs.a: Yes, we maintain Class-A General Contractor licensing with full commercial liability and worker's compensation coverage up to $10M and a 0.00 EMR safety rating.

faqs.q: How do you manage project timelines and prevent cost overruns?
faqs.a: We utilize real-time BIM 3D modeling paired with digital milestone tracking so clients receive weekly progress reports and transparent cost breakdowns before work commences.
